doc_verification.detail: milvus.io/docs/limitations.md 抓取成功，原文在页：'Field | 255 characters'、'The name of a resource ... can contain numbers, letters, and underscores (_). A resource name must start with a letter or an underscore (_).' —— 与契约断言 ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ <=255 一致。注意：文档表格明列 Field 属于资源命名规则域。继承背景：契约 field_name_rules_001 系 v2.6.10→2612→2616→2617 契约继承链产物（派发方指示如实标注），本轮 live 文档复核仍成立
doc_verification.doc_quote: The name of a resource such the collection name, partition name, or index name can contain numbers, letters, and underscores (_). A resource name must start with a letter or an underscore (_). | Field | 255 characters

execution_evidence.log_pattern: dyn field '1abc' (leading digit) -> http=200 code=0 raw={"code":0,"cost":0,"data":{"insertCount":1,"insertIds":[1]}}（数字开头非法名接受并持久化）
secondary_observations: dyn field 'a-b'/'a.b'/'$x'/'a b'/''（空串）/256 长/'ffffffff...'（256 字符）/NUL 字段 -> 全部 http=200 code=0（七类非法形态全接受）
合法对照 '_ok'/'x'/255 长 -> code=0（合法值正常）
NUL dyn field -> code=0 insertIds=[2]（第二行）

http_semantics.note: 非法字段名以 2xx+code:0 接受
